title: Arisen brain: line of sight
intro: Needs DPC 0.9.6 (Reset Scripts). Play as an ARCHER Arisen, not possessing anyone, somewhere with a wall, big rock or building nearby. The overlay shows the game's wall flags live.

steps.text: Co-op and possession off. A still goblin dummy appears 14 m ahead.
You play the Arisen (not possessing). Stand where you can clearly SEE the dummy. Press End

expect.label: visible: game says no wall from the player

steps.text: Walk behind a wall, rock or building so the dummy is fully HIDDEN from the Arisen. Press End

expect.label: hidden: game says wall from the player

steps.text: Turn the camera so you look AT the hiding spot from the side (camera can see the dummy, the Arisen can't), if you can. Press End
Stay hidden. Next the Arisen fights on his own WITH the new line-of-sight rule. Hands off after you press End
Hands off - watch: does he stop shooting the wall and walk round to get a clear shot?

expect.label: he got a hit in after moving

probes.los:
local function nearest()
  local a = H.arisen(); if not a then return nil end
  local ap = a:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
  local em = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.EnemyManager")
  local arr = em and em:call("getAllEnemies"); if not arr then return nil end
  local best, bd
  for i = 0, arr:call("get_Count") - 1 do
    local ok, e = pcall(function() return arr[i]:get_field("_Chara") end)
    if ok and e and (e:call("get_Hp") or 0) > 0 then
      local p = e:call("get_Transform"):call("get_Position")
      local d = math.sqrt((p.x - ap.x) ^ 2 + (p.z - ap.z) ^ 2)
      if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = e, d end
    end
  end
  return best, bd
end

local e = nearest(); if not e then return "no enemy" end
local w = e:call("get_LockOnTarget"):call("get_work")
local function b(n) local ok, v = pcall(w.get_field, w, n); return ok and tostring(v) or "ERR" end
return "wall=" .. b("isWall") .. " pl=" .. b("isWallPL") .. " cam=" .. b("isWallCam") .. " casted=" .. b("IsRayCasted") .. " valid=" .. b("isValid")
